entities.name: Tyrosyl-tRNA synthetase
observations: The 426-residue query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Aliivibrio fischeri tyrosyl-tRNA ligase Q5E424.
Swiss-Prot annotation assigns EC 6.1.1.1 and describes two-step Tyr-tRNA(Tyr) formation through Tyr-AMP.
The protein contains the class I aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase HIGH region, a KMSKS region, the tRNA-synt_1b domain, and a C-terminal S4 RNA-binding domain.
Reviewed homologs indicate a cytoplasmic homodimer.

entities.name: Tyrosyl-tRNA aminoacylation
observations: Overall reaction: tRNA(Tyr) + L-tyrosine + ATP → L-tyrosyl-tRNA(Tyr) + AMP + diphosphate + H(+).
Mechanism proceeds via activation of tyrosine to Tyr-AMP, followed by transfer of tyrosine to the 3′ acceptor end of tRNA(Tyr).
Assigned EC 6.1.1.1; mapped to Rhea RHEA:10220, with related entries RHEA:9706 and RHEA:9707.

entities.name: Tyrosyl-tRNA synthetase size
observations: Query sequence length is 426 amino acids; estimated molecular mass is 46,879.5 Da.
